---
title: CE certificates and your training records
audience: all
route: /clinical-development
---

**To submit a CE card or certificate you earned: upload it in Paycom** — the portal itself has no employee upload for certificates. Records are imported from Paycom into your clinical file on the next records import, so a copy uploaded there gets picked up automatically. (If you're unsure where in Paycom, ask HR via [Admin Staff](/admin-staff).)

**Certificates from WCEMS lectures** are generated by the training team after the class — you qualify by checking in, submitting the evaluation, and passing the quiz if there is one. They're emailed to the work email you registered with.

**Where your records live:** your clinical file. On [My Progress](/clinical-development) you can see:

- Your credential dates and compliance status (cards, jurisprudence, and so on).
- **My documents** — files the Clinical Development staff have shared to your file, which can include CE certificates and cert cards they've filed for you.
- Certificates from required-training modules download at completion and can be re-downloaded from each module's page under [Required Training](/training/required).

If a card you renewed still shows the old date, give the import a few days or contact Clinical Development — they can file the card directly to your record.
